gaps.title: 加航訂購8架空中巴士A350-1000，執飛波音777-300ER到不了的直飛航線
gaps.enTitle: Air Canada orders 8 Airbus A350-1000s to fly nonstop where its Boeing 777-300ERs cannot
gaps.summary: Air Canada has ordered eight Airbus A350-1000s, with deliveries starting in 2030, to replace its aging Boeing 777-300ERs on ultra-long-haul routes. The A350's 9,000-nautical-mile range removes the weight restrictions the 777 faces on detoured Asia routes.

gaps.enTitle: China Airlines posts record first-nine-months revenue of NT$185.94 billion, EPS of NT$1.8
gaps.summary: China Airlines posted record first-nine-months revenue of NT$185.94 billion and earnings per share of NT$1.8, with revenue and profit both at all-time highs for the period; passenger and cargo revenue set records together.

gaps.summary: China Airlines chairman Kao Hsing-huang says the carrier will push hard in the fourth quarter across passenger and cargo; EVA Air's December Delhi launch is already sold out on its first two flights, with North American load factors staying strong.

gaps.enTitle: NATO opens counter-drone marketplace with 16 systems from five companies
gaps.summary: NATO launched a counter-drone marketplace on November 5, letting allies order from a catalog of 16 preselected systems without a separate tender; French firm Alta Ares secured six of the 16 lots.

gaps.enTitle: Bomb threats target Ryanair, Wizz Air, LOT and SAS flights within hours
gaps.summary: Ryanair, Wizz Air, LOT Polish Airlines and SAS aircraft were targeted by a series of bomb threats within hours on November 3, 2026. A LOT flight diverted, an SAS flight landed normally, and checks found no explosives on the aircraft inspected.
